subject.title: Fix container image upgrade migrations before gateway readiness

question: Should foreground container gateway startup run state migrations plus post-core plugin convergence before readiness, including configured-plugin package repair when the existing convergence path decides it is needed?
rationale: The patch fixes a real false-ready upgrade path, but it intentionally moves upgrade convergence and possible package repair into gateway startup and can change existing operator availability behavior.

options.title: Accept startup convergence
options.body: Proceed with startup performing safe convergence work before readiness, with failures blocking readiness and directing operators to doctor repair.

options.title: Limit startup to state-only gating
options.body: Keep the version checkpoint and state migration readiness gate, but leave configured-plugin package repair to explicit update or doctor flows.

options.title: Keep convergence explicit
options.body: Do not move post-core convergence into startup; fail with a clear repair command when a version transition is detected.

recommendation.title: Accept startup convergence
recommendation.body: Proceed with startup performing safe convergence work before readiness, with failures blocking readiness and directing operators to doctor repair.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the closest recent gateway startup bootstrap boundary that this PR extends.
